```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 420

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sliderInput("n", "Valor", 1, 100, 50),
  plotOutput("plot")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    plot(seq_len(input$n), type = "l")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
